> # Faster Crush on big repos If you've been following our recent releases, you probably noticed we're frequently shipping performance improvements. We really want Crush to be light on CPU, memory and disk. For this release, our talented contributor @acmacalister did an incredible job on profiling and addressing a few performance bottlenecks for projects with many files (the so-called monorepos). This greatly reduces both CPU usage and disk access for these big projects. Enjoy!
